d: MLC Election 2026 ki matganna ke bich mokama ke purv vidhayak aur bahubli neta anant sinh ki mushkilen lagatar barhti ja rahi hain. jan suraj pratyashi do. anuj sinh ke paksh men chunav prachar karne ke aarop men jediyu (JDU) se 6 sal ke lie nishkasit kie jane aur bhavan nirman vibhag dvara 25 navanbar tak sarkari aavas khali karne ka notis milne ke bad ab unke sir par jel jane ki talvar latak gaee hai.
